details.name: Description
details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. Temenos' T24 product is a modularised, integrated real time, multi-currency, multi-branch, user-parameterised Banking system serving International Private Banking, Commercial Businesses (Crown Dependencies) and Retail (Crown Dependencies) with Currency Banking needs. The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). Current Temenos Release Version R22. Former Aliases include: Ocean R16, Ocean G13, Globus. Previously mapped Rulesafe Asset: 5393

details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. Temenos' T24 product is a modularised, integrated real time, multi-currency, multi-branch, user-parameterised Banking system serving International Private Banking, Commercial Businesses (Crown Dependencies) and Retail (Crown Dependencies) with Currency Banking needs. The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). details.name: Description
details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. Temenos' T24 product is a modularised, integrated real time, multi-currency, multi-branch, user-parameterised Banking system serving International Private Banking, Commercial Businesses (Crown Dependencies) and Retail (Crown Dependencies) with Currency Banking needs. The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). Current Temenos Release Version R22. Former Aliases include: Ocean R16, Ocean G13, Globus. Previously mapped Rulesafe Asset: 5393

details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. details.name: Description
details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. Temenos' T24 product is a modularised, integrated real time, multi-currency, multi-branch, user-parameterised Banking system serving International Private Banking, Commercial Businesses (Crown Dependencies) and Retail (Crown Dependencies) with Currency Banking needs. details.name: Description
details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. Temenos' T24 product is a modularised, integrated real time, multi-currency, multi-branch, user-parameterised Banking system serving International Private Banking, Commercial Businesses (Crown Dependencies) and Retail (Crown Dependencies) with Currency Banking needs. The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). Current Temenos Release Version R22. Former Aliases include: Ocean R16, Ocean G13, Globus. Previously mapped Rulesafe Asset: 5393

details.name: Description
details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. Temenos' T24 product is a modularised, integrated real time, multi-currency, multi-branch, user-parameterised Banking system serving International Private Banking, Commercial Businesses (Crown Dependencies) and Retail (Crown Dependencies) with Currency Banking needs. The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). Current Temenos Release Version R22. Former Aliases include: Ocean R16, Ocean G13, Globus. Previously mapped Rulesafe Asset: 5393

details.name: Description
details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. Temenos' T24 product is a modularised, integrated real time, multi-currency, multi-branch, user-parameterised Banking system serving International Private Banking, Commercial Businesses (Crown Dependencies) and Retail (Crown Dependencies) with Currency Banking needs. The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). Current Temenos Release Version R22. Former Aliases include: Ocean R16, Ocean G13, Globus. Previously mapped Rulesafe Asset: 5393

The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). details.name: Description
details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. Temenos' T24 product is a modularised, integrated real time, multi-currency, multi-branch, user-parameterised Banking system serving International Private Banking, Commercial Businesses (Crown Dependencies) and Retail (Crown Dependencies) with Currency Banking needs. The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). Current Temenos Release Version R22. Former Aliases include: Ocean R16, Ocean G13, Globus. Previously mapped Rulesafe Asset: 5393

details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. Temenos' T24 product is a modularised, integrated real time, multi-currency, multi-branch, user-parameterised Banking system serving International Private Banking, Commercial Businesses (Crown Dependencies) and Retail (Crown Dependencies) with Currency Banking needs. The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). Current Temenos Release Version R22. Former Aliases include: Ocean R16, Ocean G13, Globus. Previously mapped Rulesafe Asset: 5393

The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). details.name: Description
details.value: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets (Crown Dependencies) core banking platform. Temenos' T24 product is a modularised, integrated real time, multi-currency, multi-branch, user-parameterised Banking system serving International Private Banking, Commercial Businesses (Crown Dependencies) and Retail (Crown Dependencies) with Currency Banking needs. The Application supports Multiple Product Types (including Fixed, Current, Savings), Accounting, Payment Processing, Batch Processing, and Real Time Online Interactions via Internet Banking Interface IBX (AL01193). Current Temenos Release Version R22. Former Aliases include: Ocean R16, Ocean G13, Globus. Previously mapped Rulesafe Asset: 5393
